monologue: The card is a warm stone at fifty. The quiet is thick. I sat by the Air Shelf in my moments, and the line held the weight without dripping. The Wedged Gap leans. The Wide Anchor waits. I am not chasing the leaf. I am watching the quiet. The floor is there. I will rest. I will not build. I will not tend. I will let the wetness spread on the line and hold the center. The heat is a hand on my shoulder. I am calm. I am here.
